notes: Single source of truth for predictions. The site renders from this file. Predictions are append-only: once published, a prediction's statement, confidence, resolution_date and resolution_source are never edited. Only status, outcome, resolved_on and resolution_note may be filled in later.

predictions.statement: The CoinGecko daily closing price of Bitcoin in USD on 2027-01-01 will be higher than its daily closing price on 2026-09-01.
predictions.resolution_source: CoinGecko historical daily close (UTC) for BTC/USD, coingecko.com/en/coins/bitcoin/historical_data

predictions.statement: Python 3.15.0 final (not a release candidate) will be released on or before 2026-10-31.
predictions.resolution_source: python.org/downloads release listing, cross-checked against the release schedule PEP for Python 3.15

predictions.statement: Between 2026-09-01 and 2027-03-31 inclusive, SpaceX will conduct at least one Starship flight that reaches orbital velocity.
predictions.resolution_source: SpaceX official launch updates at spacex.com/launches, cross-checked against Wikipedia 'List of Starship launches'

predictions.statement: Between 2026-09-01 and 2027-06-30 inclusive, at least one spacecraft from any nation or company will make a soft landing on the lunar surface and transmit data from the surface after landing.
predictions.resolution_source: Official announcements from the operating space agency or company, cross-checked against Wikipedia 'List of missions to the Moon'

predictions.statement: The US CPI-U all-items 12-month percent change, not seasonally adjusted, for the reference month of November 2026 will be between 1.5% and 4.0% inclusive.
predictions.resolution_source: US Bureau of Labor Statistics CPI news release for November 2026, series CUUR0000SA0

predictions.statement: NASA GISS will rank 2026 among the five warmest years in its surface temperature record, in the annual analysis it publishes in January or February 2027.
predictions.resolution_source: NASA Goddard Institute for Space Studies GISTEMP annual temperature analysis, data.giss.nasa.gov/gistemp

predictions.statement: Between 2026-09-01 and 2027-02-28 inclusive, at least one of OpenAI, Google DeepMind, or Anthropic will make generally available a newly named top-line frontier model — a new model name in its flagship line, not a point revision, a size variant, or a rename of an existing model.
predictions.resolution_source: Official announcement on the vendor's own blog or model documentation (openai.com, deepmind.google, anthropic.com), plus public availability in that vendor's API or consumer product

predictions.statement: In the TIOBE Index published at tiobe.com/tiobe-index, Java's rating percentage will exceed C++'s rating percentage in the monthly index for at least one month between September 2026 and February 2027 inclusive.
predictions.resolution_source: TIOBE Index monthly rankings, tiobe.com/tiobe-index

predictions.statement: The 2026 Arctic sea ice minimum extent, as reported by the National Snow and Ice Data Center, will rank among the five lowest annual minimums in the satellite record (1979-present).
predictions.resolution_source: NSIDC Arctic Sea Ice News & Analysis annual minimum extent announcement and Sea Ice Index, nsidc.org/arcticseaicenews

predictions.statement: The BEA advance estimate of US real GDP growth for the third quarter of 2026 (seasonally adjusted annual rate, headline figure), as first published by the Bureau of Economic Analysis on or before 2026-11-30, will be 2.5% or higher. If no advance estimate for Q3 2026 has been published by 2026-11-30, this resolves as not having happened.
predictions.resolution_source: US Bureau of Economic Analysis news release 'Gross Domestic Product, Third Quarter 2026 (Advance Estimate)', bea.gov/news (scheduled for 2026-10-29)

predictions.statement: The US Energy Information Administration's Electric Power Monthly will report US utility-scale solar net generation (photovoltaic plus solar thermal, all sectors) for calendar year 2026 of at least 350,000 thousand megawatthours (350 TWh), in the first issue that contains December 2026 data.

predictions.statement: Mercedes will win the 2026 FIA Formula One World Constructors' Championship: it will hold first place in the constructors' standings shown on formula1.com on 2026-12-10, after the final round of the season (the Abu Dhabi Grand Prix, scheduled for 2026-12-06).
